steps.en: Install the single self-contained pandoc binary
steps.zh: 装上自包含的 pandoc 二进制
steps.code: brew install pandoc · choco install pandoc

steps.en: Write the document once in Markdown, with footnotes, citations and math
steps.zh: 用 Markdown 写一遍，脚注、引文、公式都写在里面

steps.en: Run pandoc naming the input and the output file
steps.zh: 运行 pandoc，写明输入和输出文件名

steps.en: Guesses both formats from the file extensions and parses the input into its AST
steps.zh: 按扩展名猜出两端格式，把输入解析成 AST

steps.en: Renders the AST with the target writer; for PDF, hands the result to a PDF engine
steps.zh: 用目标格式的写出器渲染 AST；要 PDF 就交给 PDF 引擎

steps.en: Writes the output file, keeping structure and dropping layout details the AST cannot hold
steps.zh: 写出文件：结构保住，AST 装不下的版式细节丢掉

value.en: One source becomes HTML, Word, PDF or EPUB without hand-copying between tools
value.zh: 一份源文件出 HTML、Word、PDF、EPUB，不用在工具之间手工搬

sources: https://github.com/jgm/pandoc/blob/main/MANUAL.txt#using-pandoc, #specifying-formats (formats guessed from extensions), #creating-a-pdf (pandoc test.txt -o test.pdf, LaTeX by default, --pdf-engine)
